title: Global Smoke Forecast
abstract: Where wildfire smoke is drifting around the world. This animation from NOAA's global GEFS-Aerosols model traces smoke high in the atmosphere as winds carry it away from fires burning across the planet. Brighter areas mean thicker smoke overhead; dark areas are clear skies. The forecast runs from {{valid_iso:PT6H:PT9H}} out to {{valid_iso:PT6H:PT9H:PT120H}} — about five days — and refreshes automatically with each new model run.
